system.name: AUGUSTUS
system.one_liner: An LLM-driven multimodal agent whose graph-structured contextual memory follows a human-memory loop: encode, store, retrieve, act.

content.variant_note: the agent's four-stage loop drawn above a mirrored human-memory loop, matching parts at matching positions
content.argues: AUGUSTUS' encode-store-retrieve-act loop mirrors human memory: the limited in-context memory plays working memory and a ~infinite-size external memory plays long-term memory.
content.subject: Two mirrored four-stage memory loops, the agent's above and a human's below, with matching inputs, memory stores and retrieval routes.

content.reading_order: Starts at the blue (1) Encode bar top-left, runs right along the bar and down the right edge to (4) Act, then back up the left edge; the orange lane is read as the mirrored echo of it.

layout.arrangement_note: Two horizontal lanes mirrored about the middle: the blue AUGUSTUS loop on top, the orange HUMAN loop below. Each lane is a stage-bar frame (Encode, Store in Memory, Retrieve on the outer edge, Act on the inner edge, closed by a rectangular loop arrow) around three columns split by dashed lines: a 2x2 input grid, a memory frame with a limited-size box over a dashed region of two cylinders, and a two-cell retrieval column. A staggered row of function-call chips sits between the two Act bars.

lessons.what_to_learn: State an analogy by redrawing the human counterpart as a mirror-image lane that reuses the method's own layout, so each part is compared with its counterpart by position and colour alone; close a cycle with stage bars as a frame and one rectangular loop arrow.

summary: AUGUSTUS is an LLM-driven multimodal agent that keeps a graph-structured contextual memory and works in a loop of encode, store in memory, retrieve and act, modelled on human memory. Figure 1 draws two mirrored lanes: a blue upper lane for AUGUSTUS (robot mascot) and an orange lower lane for a human (cartoon boy). Both have the same four numbered stage bars closed by a rectangular loop arrow and the same three columns: a 2x2 grid of icons for inputs (Audio, Image, Text, Video against Acoustic, Visual, Tactile, Semantic), a memory frame with a limited-size box over a dashed ~Infinite Size region of two cylinders, and a two-cell retrieval column. A row of monospace function-call chips sits between the two Act bars.
summary_zh: AUGUSTUS 是带上下文用户记忆的多模态 LLM 智能体。图用上下两条镜像泳道对照智能体与人类记忆：同样的编码、存储、检索、行动四步循环，同样的输入网格、有限与无限记忆、检索列，中间一排函数调用标签。
notes: Prior kinds kept (analogy primary); the prior pass counted two panels, but the lanes are not separately framed or lettered, so they are recorded as lanes of one drawing. The 14 bitmaps are the two characters and 12 icons; icon origin (stock) and character origin (generated) are judged from style only. The role of the function-call chips is only implied by position.
